name: CTU-CHB Intrapartum Cardiotocography Database
description: The CTU-CHB Intrapartum Cardiotocography Database is an obstetrical and fetal monitoring collection compiled by the Czech Technical University in Prague and University Hospital in Brno (UHB). It contains 552 intrapartum cardiotocography (CTG) recordings (fetal heart rate and uterine contractions, sampled at 4 Hz) collected between 2009 and 2012, with each recording up to 90 minutes in length and terminating directly before delivery. Records are accompanied by objective newborn outcomes, maternal and labor characteristics, and biochemical fetal blood gas measurements (umbilical artery pH, base deficit, and pCO2), providing an objective ground truth for automated fetal hypoxia and metabolic acidosis detection.
